SELECT car_id AS carId, car_no AS carNo, maker_code AS makerCode, model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, model_code AS modelCode, trim_code AS trimCode, grade_code AS gradeCode, maker_name AS makerName, model_group_name AS modelGroupName, model_name AS modelName, trim_name AS trimName, year AS year, mileage AS mileage, color AS color, transmission AS transmission, fuel AS fuel, region AS region, displacement AS displacement, body_type AS bodyType, adv_status AS advStatus, last_seen_date AS lastSeenDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM car_master
